## Triage: closed `not_planned` on first touch. A PM-tooling finding with neither queue-entry line

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T11:07Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why it closes:** it is a finding about PM or gate tooling (`lanes/ui.md against objectui's workflow header`). It has no `Unblocks: #N` naming an open product card it blocks, and no published surface it guards. The product-only queue rule closes it on first touch.
- **The instance is ruled:** 「等 12030 升级完之后再处理main红。」 (objectstack-ai/objectui#12325, `6143739179`). The next instance is decided the same way, by the maintainer or by whichever text the maintainer names.
- **Re-entry:** a new card whose first line is `Unblocks: #N` (an open product card measured blocked by it), or the maintainer directing the fix.
- The handoff item is recorded. Nothing is lost by closing.
